summary: Iteration-0 problems are fixed: no foot penetration, a readable coil at f4-5, a 3-frame strike (67/132/117 deg per frame) into a moving hold, fist at chin height, hips-chest-elbow now sequenced (overlap 1.0). The accel spikes and velocity corners are all on the strike start/stop (f5-9) and read as the intended snap, not pops. One regression blocks approval: the root now drifts upward and the whole character hovers through the strike.

findings.observation: Both feet are off the floor on f4-17 (both_feet_airborne_frames; lowest foot z 0.11 at f4 rising to 0.27-0.28 at f11-13; visible gap under the feet in the side view f8-f15). LowerTorso ly climbs from -0.03 to +0.27 at f12 although the legs never move, so the correct height is constant: the per-frame value that grounds the lowest foot is -0.03 on every frame (within 0.04). This was introduced by the iteration-0 plant_feet pass (it reported a max correction of 0.104 but the keys ramp to +0.27), so plant_feet is not used here. The rear foot is also 0.07 above the floor at f0/f24 with the front foot grounded; 5 deg less ankle compensation puts its toe down.
